title: Unkey API Key
description: Represents an API key managed by the Unkey platform, including its configuration, permissions, rate limits, and credit settings.

apiId.description: ID of the API namespace this key belongs to

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace this key belongs to

prefix.description: Key prefix shown before the hash (e.g. sk, pk, test)

start.description: First few characters of the key for identification without exposing the full key

externalId.description: External identifier linking the key to a user or organization in your system

identityId.description: ID of the identity this key belongs to

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the key

permissions.description: Permissions directly assigned to this key

enabled.description: Whether the key is currently active

plaintext.description: Plaintext key value — only returned on creation, never stored

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the key was created

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the key was last updated

expires.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the key expires, or null if it does not expire

deletedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the key was deleted

ratelimit.description: Rate limit configuration for this key

async.description: Whether rate limit updates are applied asynchronously

limit.description: Maximum number of requests in the window

duration.description: Rate limit window duration in milliseconds

remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window

reset.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the window resets

credits.description: Credit/usage quota configuration for this key

refillAmount.description: Amount to refill on each refill cycle

refillDay.description: Day of month to refill credits (1-31)
